title: 12 Best Marrakech's Rooftop Bars & Cocktails
description: Discover the best rooftop bars in Marrakech for stunning Medina views, vibrant atmospheres, and exquisite cocktails. From chic lounges to traditional havens, find your perfect sundowner spot.

places.name: El Fenn Rooftop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order El Fenn Sunset Cocktail (a local twist on a classic sour) or a perfectly mixed Negroni.

places.name: Kabana Marrakech
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their signature 'Kabana Spritz' for a refreshing twist or one of their expertly muddled fruit cocktails.

places.name: Nomad
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Spiced Orange Blossom Spritzer' (non-alcoholic) or a glass of local Moroccan wine with their delicious lamb tagine.

places.name: Terrasse des Épices
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a traditional Moroccan mint tea or a freshly squeezed orange juice while soaking in the square's energy.

places.name: Le Salama
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Moroccan Mojito' with fresh mint and a hint of argan is a popular choice, or a classic gin and tonic.

places.name: Café des Épices
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Moroccan Mint Tea with some almond pastries, or a refreshing fresh orange juice.

places.name: La Pergola
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Aperol Spritz' for a refreshing afternoon drink or one of their house white wines with a seafood platter.

places.name: Kasbah Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cold Casablanca beer after exploring the tombs, or a 'Citron Pressé' (fresh lemon juice).

places.name: Dar Dar Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Dar Dar Delight' cocktail, featuring local spices and fresh fruit, is highly recommended.

places.name: Maison Arabe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Old Fashioned' or a 'French 75' – their mixologists are top-tier. Pair it with some Moroccan canapés.

places.name: Rooftop Garden at The Secret Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A homemade iced tea or a traditional 'Nous Nous' coffee (half milk, half espresso) with a view of the garden.

places.name: Atay Cafe & Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Mint & Ginger Lemonade' is incredibly refreshing, or a traditional Moroccan tagine with fresh bread.
